verdict.rationale: The Scribe product page names EU and India data residency as a first-party option, so users have some choice of where data is stored. The pack gives only that one marketing line, with no documentation of how to select a region or what it covers. Missing for 10: documentation of how to select a region (endpoints, settings, or plan requirements), the full list of available regions and what data each covers, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
